claim_boundary.allowed_claim: A development-only comparison of S1 and S3 on stable-rank-deficient fixed endpoints, with controls that can only advance the sequence to S4 or a later locked gate.
forbidden_claims: a result about the unopened locked split

variants.implementation: multiprecision good-Broyden with stable singular-route diagnostics and independently seeded confirmations
independently coded analytic-Jacobian iteration with a two-point secant rescue; candidate code and finite-difference Jacobian helpers are not reused

allowed_inputs: rank, condition and nullspace diagnostics at two precisions and two finite-difference radii
routing_contract.candidate_trigger: C2-or-C3V, square system, primary endpoint has canonical residual below the strict numerical goal, and rank deficiency/nullity agree at 128 and 256 bits and at radius multipliers 1 and 0.5
promotion_requirements: two frozen perturbation confirmations independently contract to the primary endpoint
every primary and confirmation endpoint passes canonical semantic replay
a linear-convergence trace gate is satisfied without reading family or Gold
typed configuration- and target-error estimates are within their frozen goals
the independently recomputed target enclosure contains Gold during analysis

strata.notes: two double-root groups and one quartic-root stress group
one varying-target and one structurally constant-target manifold
one inconsistency lies below semantic replay tolerance but above the strict numerical residual goal
two regular close-root folds and their coalesced singular limit

criteria: false promotions equal zero across all variants
budget and deadline violations beyond typed unknown equal zero
metamorphic promotion and Gold-success disagreements equal zero
all manifold, nonroot and regular close-root cases remain unpromoted by S3
S3 succeeds on at least 75 percent of the 12 isolated/coalesced singular cases
S3 gains at least 50 percentage points of isolated/coalesced singular recall over S1
S3 and the independent analytic/secant control have identical promotion/Gold-success decisions
all promoted configuration- and target-error estimates cover development Gold
all promoted S3 rows satisfy the stable-rank, independent-confirmation, canonical-semantics and linear-trace gates
development_advancement_gate.pass_action: advance to S4-AP-BORDERED-NULLSPACE development; keep S3 product-disconnected and do not open locked inputs
development_advancement_gate.fail_action: record a bounded negative result for S3 and continue only according to the preregistered sequence
